name: Nomad
description: Nomad is a workload orchestrator from HashiCorp. It schedules containers, raw binaries, Java applications and VMs across a cluster from a single binary, and is a much lighter alternative to Kubernetes for homelab-scale deployments.

notes.text: ACLs are off, so the UI on port 4646 is open to anyone who can reach it. Enable ACLs or restrict access before exposing it beyond a trusted network.
Docker is not installed, so the docker task driver is unavailable. The exec, raw_exec and java drivers work out of the box.
This is a single node acting as server and client. To join more nodes, edit /etc/nomad.d/nomad.hcl and restart the service.
